name: Mechanically latched relay coil
summary: A mechanically latched relay retains a documented state after the initiating electrical command is removed.
description: A mechanically latched relay retains a documented state after the initiating electrical command is removed. The schematic needs both the operating and reset mechanism so the retained state can be understood.
readingNotes: Identify the reset or unlatching path instead of assuming removal of coil power releases the contacts.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A latched relay retains state; a conventional monostable relay returns when its operating condition is removed.
